lines.trans: What are you doing sitting out here by yourself?

words.gram: Meaning: what are you doing / why.

lines.trans: I am just sitting here for a bit and taking a look around.
What are you looking at out here?
Xingzi asked me to come over and check.
How long have you been staying out here?
Not long; when I walked past this afternoon, I saw Wen Simo.
He looked rather unhappy and said he was looking for you, so I stayed to check.
You stayed here from the afternoon until now—are you being silly, or do you have too much free time?
I do not really know why either.
Hurry inside; what happened to your foot?
It is fine; my leg just went a little numb from sitting.
Is your foot really alright? Maybe you should get it checked at the hospital.
